BROWSERSTACK_USERNAME.description: BrowserStack never describes this half's own risk, but its CI guide stores it as a secret beside the key, so it is kept at that level here.

BROWSERSTACK_ACCESS_KEY.description: BrowserStack calls it a sensitive authentication token. Unusually, it rotates in place: an API call returns the old and new values together, so the username never changes and callers move over at their own pace.
